display_long_description:
Vertex VR Video Player — a powerful VR video player for Meta Quest.

  Projection modes:
  - Flat screen (cinema-style)
  - 180° and 360° sphere
  - EAC (YouTube 360)

  Stereo: SBS, Top-Bottom, Mono, SBS Fisheye

  Key features:
  - Play Multiple — watch up to 3 videos simultaneously. Flat stacked mode or 180°+Flat mixed mode with gaze-based audio switching
  - CAS (Contrast Adaptive Sharpening) with sRGB-correct color pipeline
  - 6 color profiles: Realism, Vivid, Teal & Orange, Vintage, PhotoReal, 3D
  - Adjustable sharpness, clarity, brightness, contrast, saturation, gamma, warmth, depth effect
  - Smooth playback with optimized buffering
  - 4K and 8K video decoding
  - Internal storage and USB OTG (NTFS) playback
  - Auto-detection of video type from filename and resolution
  - VR menu with drag to pan, thumbstick to zoom
  - Synchronized multi-video controls
  - Mirror mode, eye swap, passthrough background

  No account required, no internet needed — just load and play.
